challenges.title: Carrier registration is slow and manual
challenges.text: Sending business texts in the US means registering brands and campaigns with carriers. Done by hand, that delays every new customer.

challenges.title: Customers needed to serve themselves
challenges.text: Buying numbers, tracking delivery, reading logs and understanding spend all had to work without a support ticket.

challenges.title: Messaging data is sensitive
challenges.text: Message content, phone numbers and billing records need strict account isolation and controlled access.

results: Customers register, buy numbers and start sending from a self-serve portal
Registration, provisioning and billing steps automated
Dashboards for delivery, usage and call analytics
Integrations for CRMs and AI agents on the same API
Every release verified in staging and production
name: Signal House
headline: A self-serve messaging and voice platform built for businesses and AI agents
overview: Signal House is a communications platform that gives businesses SMS, MMS and voice APIs over direct carrier connections, across 10DLC, toll-free and short code numbers. Techlio built the product end to end, from discovery and design through development, deployment and ongoing support: the self-serve customer portal, automated registration and billing flows, analytics dashboards and the integrations that let CRMs and AI agents send messages through the platform.

metrics.label: channels on one platform: 10DLC, toll-free, short code, voice
CPaaS provider on G2, as listed by Signal House

solutions.title: Self-serve customer portal
solutions.text: Registration, account settings, number management, message logs and call logs in one portal, rebuilt as Portal V2.

solutions.title: Automated onboarding and billing
solutions.text: Brand and campaign registration, number provisioning, usage rating and rebilling run as automated workflows instead of manual back-office steps.

solutions.title: Analytics dashboards
solutions.text: Delivery, usage and call analytics so customers and the Signal House team can see volume, deliverability and spend at a glance.

solutions.title: AI agent and CRM integrations
solutions.text: API and integration work that lets AI agents and tools such as GoHighLevel send and track messages, including notes synced to the right contact and call activity shown inside the conversation channel.

solutions.title: Security built in
solutions.text: Techlio's security baseline applied from the first sprint: OWASP-based secure coding and review, role-based access control, encryption in transit and at rest, least-privilege access to cloud resources and vulnerability scans before each release. For Signal House that covers per-account data isolation, API key handling and two-factor verification flows.
